steps.name: disable-obsolete-s8lab-only-after-main-idle-host-check
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
SERIAL="$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.device.s22_adb_discovery --serial RFCT70L7E8J)"
adbq() { adb -s "$SERIAL" "$@"; }
MAIN=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge
LAB=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.s8lab
check_safe() {
  local states mode role host
  states="$(adbq shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | tr -d '\r')"
  mode="$(adbq shell dumpsys audio | sed -n 's/.*Actual mode = \(MODE_[A-Z_]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d '\r')"
  role="$(adbq shell cmd role get-role-holders --user 0 android.app.role.DIALER | tr -d '\r')"
  host="$(adbq shell content call --uri content://pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.gsmbinder --method status)"
  [[ -n "$states" && -z "$(printf '%s\n' "$states" | grep -v '^0$' || true)" && "$mode" == MODE_NORMAL && "$role" == "$MAIN" && "$host" == *host_registered=true* ]]
}
check_safe || { echo HOLD_PHONE_OR_MAIN_HOST_NOT_READY; exit 50; }
if adbq shell pm path --user 0 "$LAB" | grep -q '^package:'; then
  adbq shell pm disable-user --user 0 "$LAB"
  adbq shell pm list packages -d --user 0 | tr -d '\r' | grep -Fx "package:$LAB"
  echo LAB_DISABLED_DATA_PRESERVED=true
else
  echo LAB_ALREADY_ABSENT=true
fi
check_safe || { echo POSTCHECK_HOLD; exit 51; }
echo MAIN_APP_AND_GSM_HOST_UNCHANGED=true
echo NO_UNINSTALL_NO_CALLS=true
